caption: Nine knots for a cubic curve. The four zeros at the start and four 2s at the end are end multiplicities, so both ends are clamped; the single 1 is an interior knot with a C² join.

spec.title: Cubic B-spline knot vector U
spec.aria: Nine knots in one row: four zeros, then a single 1 at index 4, then four 2s; the first and last knots are clamped.
